FORGE_URL.description: The base URL of GitHub's REST API; for GitHub Enterprise Server https://<host>/api/v3.

FORGE_TOKEN.description: A GitHub token that may write contents, pull requests, commit statuses and the repository's administration (branch protection, webhooks). Required by every command but event.

FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: The secret of the webhooks that webhook registers. When it is set, event refuses a delivery whose X-Hub-Signature-256 does not match.
